Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • git: add force refresh parameter to Git status queries (274a124)
  • claude: persist provider session ID for resume support (85e87d9)
  • signalr: broadcast ProjectGit snapshot updates via SignalR (e055ccb)
  • handlers: auto-refresh ProjectGit snapshot after proposal archive (d0f5eb6)
  • orleans: add ProjectGit refresh constants and watcher improvements (869fa1f)
  • orleans: add startup warmup tasks for MessageBucket and ProjectGit grains (9db2704)
  • orleans: add background refresh and stale snapshot handling to ProjectGitGrain (ae82974)

HagiCode-org/web

  • feature-home: add Product Hunt badge card and HagiPower type updates (2f46559)
  • i18n: add HagiPower chart and report translations (1cbbc6d)
  • session: add proposal archive sync and profile picker improvements (45ab1e3)
  • git: add project Git snapshot caching and archive sync events (4b27451)
  • reports: add HagiPower directional charts to hero battle report (651700d)
